title: marketplace-trial-conversion-experiment-playbook-wip
content:
Purpose:
This working doc collects hypotheses, copy permutations, technical gating, and telemetry requirements for a set of marketplace trial onboarding experiments aimed at improving free-trial -> paid conversion across AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace. Focus is on small to mid-market ISV workflows (self-serve buyers) and partner-enabled co-sell flows.

Summary of the experiment bundle (high level):
- Run 3 concurrent experiments across marketplaces: productized 14-day trial SKU, 7-day low-friction trial SKU, and a usage-based free-tier for low-volume requests.
- Measure: trial activation rate, day-7 retention (active requests), day-14 conversion to paid SKU, and trial-to-paid revenue uplift.
- Primary hypothesis: shorter, concrete trial promises (7-day with example runbook + pre-filled template) will reduce dropoff during onboarding versus a generic 14-day trial. Secondary hypothesis: marketplace listing copy that highlights predictable unit economics and SLA-ready modes (Dedicated/Private) will increase conversion for enterprise-influenced deals.

Target audiences and friction map: (notes)
- Developer-focused buyers (self-serve): want fast sign-up, working credentials, example prompts, cost estimator and demo data. Pain points: long legal flows, confusing SKUs, no immediate sample responses.
- Platform/Procure buyers: need pricing clarity, compliance notes, and a clear path to Dedicated/Private. Pain points: missing SLA text, missing procurement SKU mapping.
- Partner-managed buyers: rely on partner onboarding; care about trial activation workflows that partner can trigger and track.

Experiment matrix (sketch):
- Variant A (Control): current listing copy + 14-day trial SKU. Existing onboarding.
- Variant B (Trial Promise): 7-day "guided" trial with a 3-step quickstart (API key, run sample prompt, view cost dashboard). Listing copy emphasizes "Get value in 10 minutes."
- Variant C (Free-tier): usage-limited free tier (10k tokens/month) with optional opt-in to trial. Listing copy emphasizes developer playground and cost guardrails.
- Variant D (Enterprise CTA): 14-day trial but listing copy includes "Dedicated availability" and a clear enterprise contact CTA; reserved for partner-co-sell channel.

Key copy elements to A/B test on listing and first-run experience: (snippets / working copy)
- Headline options: "Deploy LLM inference with predictable latency and costs" vs "Start a 7-day guided LLM trial — results in 10 minutes"
- Subhead: "Hosted API, dedicated capacity, or private deployment" vs "Instant API key, sample prompts, cost preview"
- CTA variants: "Start trial" / "Activate guided trial" / "Try free tier" / "Contact sales for Dedicated"
- One-liners for tile/summary: "High-throughput LLM inference with predictable per-token economics" / "Scale to production — dedicated pools & SLA-backed latency"

Onboarding quickstart templates to pre-fill during trial activation (UI flow items):
- Template 1: "Customer support chatbot" (preloaded prompt set, sample small dataset)
- Template 2: "Search re-ranker" (sample embeddings + evaluation snippet)
- Template 3: "Assistant with function calls" (show streaming + tool-calling example)
- Each template pre-installs: sample prompt file, cost estimate for 1k tokens, recommended model variant, recommended batching and caching settings.

Technical gating checklist for marketplace submission and in-UI trial activation: (must pass before experiment launch)
- SKU mapping: trial SKU IDs created in billing backend and mapped to marketplace product IDs. Gate: finance sign-off.
- Metering & usage reporting: ensure marketplace metering hooks send daily usage to Redwood billing pipeline. Gate: end-to-end test with synthetic usage on dev account.
- Entitlement & IAM: trial entitlements provision API keys scoped to trial limits. Gate: token lifetime and revocation flows tested.
- Quota enforcement: back-end enforces per-trial quotas (tokens/minute, total tokens). Gate: throttling tests and graceful error messages.
- Telemetry: add trial cohort tag to request logs, include marketplace source label, and surface these in Console. Gate: dashboard filters validated.
- Billing fall-through: when trial ends, ensure auto-fallback path (convert to paid SKU on accepted TOS or suspend). Gate: billing workflow QA.
- Privacy/compliance blurb: include marketplace-required copy about data retention and onboarding logs. Gate: security review and legal signoff.
- Offer artifacts: screenshots, policy text, architecture diagram, and sample customer success playbook for partners. Gate: GTM asset upload ready.

Telemetry + metrics to capture (implementation notes):
- Event: trial_activated (source: AWS/Azure/GCP) with metadata: marketplace_sku, trial_variant, partner_id (if present).
- Event: quickstart_step_completed (step: API_KEY / SAMPLE_PROMPT / COST_DASHBOARD)
- Event: trial_usage_daily (tokens_used, requests, errors)
- Conversion funnel: trial_activated -> quickstart_step_1 -> quickstart_step_3 -> trial_active_day7 -> converted_to_paid
- Outcome metrics: trial_activation_rate, day7_active_pct, day14_conversion_rate, avg_revenue_per_converted (30d), time_to_first-successful-request

Legal and marketplace policy reminders (short checklist):
- Ensure listing copy doesn't promise features that require dedicated agreements (e.g., SLA-backed latency without Dedicated purchase).
- Include required marketplace privacy/data handling snippet for each cloud provider.
- Confirm trial terms and renewal behavior are visible and explicit in the listing (auto-convert? manual?).

Partner enablement assets (initial deliverables to partners):
- Short partner playbook: "How to trigger and track trial activations" (one-pager)
- Email templates for partner outreach during trial (Day 0 welcome, Day 3 best practices, Day 10 conversion nudges)
- Partner portal webhooks: documented sample payloads for trial events.
- Suggested conversation scripts for solution engineers during handoffs.

Sample partner email snippets (working):
- Day 0: "Welcome — your trial is active. Start with this quickstart and see inference results in 10 minutes. If you want a guided walkthrough, reply and we'll schedule a 30-min session."
- Day 7: "Two-thirds through your trial — want to see cost projections for Dedicated capacity? We can run a quick fit assessment."
- Day 13: "Your trial ends tomorrow — convert now to keep your API key and historical data. Special discounted pricing available for partner-introduced customers."

Measurement plan and rollout timeline (proposal):
- Week 0–1: finalize SKU and billing gates, create experiment tracking tags, and finalize listing copy for variants.
- Week 2: soft launch on sandbox marketplace entries and internal QA.
- Week 3–6: run live experiment on a subset of new listings (traffic-sampled), collect metrics, and run interim analysis at week 4.
- Week 7: finalize winning variant and prepare rollout to all marketplace entries and partner channels.

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: Marketplace metering delays causing inaccurate early telemetry. Mitigation: mirror usage with internal metering for first 14 days and reconcile nightly.
- Risk: Confusing SKUs cause billing tickets. Mitigation: add clear SKU mapping docs in partner portal and route billing inquiries to dedicated queue.
- Risk: Enterprise buyers get the wrong impression from trial copy about SLA guarantees. Mitigation: ensure every listing has an "Enterprise and Dedicated" callout with link to SLA page and contact sales CTA.

Open questions / decisions needed: (TODOs)
- Decide default trial length per marketplace (7 vs 14 days) and whether to run both simultaneously per provider. Owner: Lena (need PM decision).
- Do we auto-upgrade to a paid subscription at trial end with credit card on file? Finance and Legal input required. Linked ticket: JIRA:GTM-356.
- Which templates are included by default in the quickstart gallery? Owner: Product-Hosted-API team.
- Partner-triggered trial activation API: should partner_id be required or optional? Security review pending.

Next immediate actions (this doc is the working plan):
- Action: @Ravi to confirm SKU IDs with Finance by 2025-11-10.
- Action: @Marta to prepare three listing copy variants and upload to staging by 2025-11-14.
- Action: @Owen to validate telemetry tags and create Grafana dashboard for trial cohorts by 2025-11-17.
- Action: @Priya to draft partner playbook and two email templates by 2025-11-20.

Notes to self / friction log (raw):
- Marketplace listing length constraints differ by provider; Azure allows longer marketing blurb, AWS more structured fields. Need per-provider copy mapping.
- Avoid using phrase "unlimited" anywhere in free-tier copy.
- Ensure our Console cost preview matches marketplace listed price otherwise customers will be confused.

Appendix: example copy drafts (short)
- Quick headline: "Try Redwood Inference — 7-day guided trial, results in 10 minutes"
- Short body: "Instant API key, sample prompts for chat and search, and a cost preview tailored to your usage. No infra to manage. For enterprise needs, explore Dedicated or Private deployments with SLA options."
- CTA: "Activate guided trial"

Document history: created as a consolidation of GTM and product notes for marketplace trials. Keep this doc as the source-of-truth until we finalize SKUs and telemetry, then move final copy into the formal listing assets repo.

End of working doc.
